subject: Helios-A variant onboarding: compatibility schedule and staggered version lock
messages:
From: Sam Voss <sam@nimb.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Helios-A variant: request to be listed as a compatible variant

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks again for the demo last week. NimbleAI is ready to make the Helios-A v1.2 variant available to partners; we'd like Redwood to onboard it as a supported variant in your catalog. High level: Helios-A is a 13B decoder-only model with two quantized shipping artifacts (int8 and int4), and a small tokenizer change (bpe->bpe-v2). The external engineering team can provide weights + a quick compatibility matrix.

Are you able to run the standard compat checks and propose a staggered pin/rollout schedule? Our partners at Acme are lined up to test in early Oct and would prefer a soft launch by 10/15 if possible.

Attached: heliosA-spec-v1.2.pdf (model spec), quick eval prompts.

Let me know who on your side should own the intake checklist and which infra contacts we need to loop in.

—Sam
Platform Partnerships, NimbleAI
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Voss <sam@nimb.ai>, NimbleAI Platform Team <platform@nimb.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Helios-A variant: request to be listed as a compatible variant

Thanks Sam — we can take this on. Looping in product (Laura), runtime (Marcus), applied ML (Priyom) and infra (David) to scope the intake. A few asks up front so we can size the work and hit your Oct window: 

- Confirm canonical artifact formats (PyTorch + quantized checkpoints) and a checksum for the tokenizer (bpe-v2).
- Share a small representative eval set (we'll need ~5K prompts, ideally the attached helios-a-eval-prompts.txt is a start).
- Any custom ops or fused kernels required by your int4 path? If yes, we need to know before we schedule canaries.

Proposed process on our side: compat smoke -> quantization parity checks -> perf/latency regression -> canary in staging -> staggered version lock by latency class & region (us-west first). Can everyone confirm feasibility? Marcus/Priyom/David: can you each call out blockers and an ETA for the checklist?

I'll publish a short intake doc to the Helios folder and draft a tentative rollout calendar once we have your artifacts.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Product Manager, Model Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-19T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Helios-A variant: request to be listed as a compatible variant

Stephanie —

Quick tech read from runtime: we can run the compatibility tests but need clarity on two items before committing to a 10/15 soft launch: 

1) Tokenizer parity: bpe-v2 can be handled but we need the tokenizer files + a small test corpus to validate token IDs don't shift for common prefixes. Token ID drift will break KV cache and will require a migration plan.

2) Int4 runtime: if NimbleAI's int4 relies on a custom fused attention kernel, we need the kernel source or a fallback plan (int8) — shipping a custom CUDA kernel inside our hosted runtime has security and validation overhead. If we can default to int8 for initial canary, that reduces risk and engineering time.

ETA: If we get artifacts by EOD 9/20, we can complete compat smoke & tokenizer parity checks by 9/24, perf baseline by 9/29, and a staging canary the week of 10/4. That timeline assumes no custom kernel.

I'll add the checklist entries to the Helios intake doc (JIRA-ISSUE-REDWOOD-8421).

Attachments: compat-checklist-template.xlsx (blank form)

—Marcus
Runtime Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-19T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Helios-A variant: request to be listed as a compatible variant

Thanks — a couple of ML items: 

- We'll run a small calibration eval (safety checks + quality delta vs our current default 13B variant). Please share the 5K prompts; if Nimble can flag sensitive prompt classes that would be helpful.
- For quantized variants, we need the exact quant config (scale/zero-point, per-channel vs per-tensor) and a reference FP32 run for signal alignment. If Nimble can provide evaluation scripts that reproduce their internal numbers, that speeds things up.

Proposed quality gate: pass for classification/QA metrics within 2% of baseline on the eval set AND no new high-severity safety regressions in the safety suite. If those are met we proceed to perf staging.

Also: recommend a staggered pin: 1) staging canary for engineers 2) low-latency traffic class in us-west 3) broader us rollout 4) EU after compliance checks. Pin durations should be 72h per stage with abort windows.

—Priyom
Applied ML Engineer
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-20T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Helios-A variant: request to be listed as a compatible variant

Operational notes: 

- Storage: Helios-A int4 artifacts will increase artifact registry entries. We'll need an S3 lifecycle plan for older checkpoints.
- Routing: suggest implementing a feature-flagged routing policy keyed by "variant.pin.HeliosA" and a latency class header to enable the staggered rollout.
- Fallbacks: implement an automatic fallback to the int8 variant and to our current default 13B if latency or error rates exceed thresholds. Also instrument token-level cost and tail-latency metrics for the canary windows.

If the partner requires SLA exceptions for early enterprise testers (Acme), we should capture that as a separate contract action.

I'll coordinate with infra to reserve canary capacity the week of 10/4. If artifacts arrive by 9/20 EOD as Marcus asked, we are good to schedule.

—David
Infra Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Voss <sam@nimb.ai>, NimbleAI Platform Team <platform@nimb.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: 2027-09-21T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Helios-A variant: request to be listed as a compatible variant — plan and next steps

Sam — thanks for the artifacts you shipped this morning (I see heliosA-spec-v1.2.pdf in the folder). Recap + decisions from our side: 

1) Intake owner: Product (Laura) will drive the intake and sign off readiness gates.
2) Timeline: Artifacts received 9/21 -> tokenizer parity & compat smoke by 9/24 -> perf baseline & quant parity by 9/29 -> staging canary week of 10/4 -> low-latency us-west soft launch 10/11 -> broader us rollout 10/18. EU pending compliance checks (separate thread).
3) Quant path: we will run int8 baseline and attempt int4 in staging. If Nimble cannot supply a non-proprietary int4 path, we fallback to int8 for initial pin.
4) Staggered pin plan: 72h observation windows per stage; automated rollback triggers on >3x error rate or >150% token-latency P95 vs baseline.
5) Action items: Nimble to upload tokenizer files + checksum and explicit quant config (Priyom's request). Marcus to complete kernel/ops feasibility by 9/24. David to reserve canary capacity. Laura to publish intake doc and add JIRA-ISSUE-REDWOOD-8421 test checklist entries.

I've scheduled a 30-min sync for Tue 9/28 10:00 AM PT to review compat results — calendar invite sent. If Acme needs SLA exceptions for their early test cohort, procurement please start that loop (cc'ing Acme procurement).

Thanks everyone — we'll track on the Helios Onboard Drive folder and JIRA-ISSUE-REDWOOD-8421.

—Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Product Manager, Model Platform
Redwood Inference
